name: Pomodoro
author: loneycoffee
description: A pomofocus.io-style Pomodoro timer for the bar: Pomodoro / Short Break / Long Break, a task list with estimated and actual pomodoros, switchable timer profiles, alarm and ticking sounds, desktop notifications and a focus report. Colors follow the active Omarchy theme. Toggle the panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle loneycoffee.pomodoro

barWidget.description: Pomodoro timer with tasks; shows the time left while a round runs
